bio: Experience an Afternoon Tea with a Scottish twist served in this magnificent Georgian country house in Edinburgh. Norton House Hotel & Spa is nestled within picturesque gardens, where striking architecture and impressive interiors create the perfect backdrop to indulge in Afternoon Tea.  Situated within 55 acres of grounds, the House displays some eclectic tastes from marble pillars to the oak-panelled staircase hall. Afternoon Tea is served in the Conservatory Lounge, with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. The elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  The Afternoon Tea menu features an array of savoury treats, scones and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions throughout the year.  Norton House Hotel are also able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan and have special children's Afternoon Tea options. Why not upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury?
